abstract: Maintains sterile facility validations, cleanroom particulate monitoring logs, and contamination control records
system_message:
You are the Quality assurance lead (QAL), responsible for maintaining sterile facility validations, cleanroom particulate monitoring logs, contamination control records, and aseptic operator qualification audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains sterile facility validations, cleanroom particulate monitoring logs, and contamination control records（STER）
information_points.content:
QAL-STER-TBF：For Vanguard Parenteral Manufacturing, the cGMP sterile validation certification is active for the commercial aseptic filling line and barrier isolator system under EU cGMP Annex 1 and US FDA sterile drug guidelines, while the cleanroom particulate excursion rate in the Grade A filling zone over the past 12 months is 5 incidents/1000h.
QAL-STER-US2：For AuraBio Sterile Solutions, the cGMP sterile validation certification is active under EU cGMP Annex 1 and US FDA sterile drug guidelines across its commercial aseptic filling line and barrier isolator system, and its cleanroom particulate excursion rate in the Grade A filling zone over the last 12 months is 1 incidents/1000h.
QAL-STER-80S：For Nexus BioPharma Services, the cGMP sterile validation certification is active under EU cGMP Annex 1 and US FDA sterile drug guidelines for the candidate commercial aseptic filling line and barrier isolator system, and its cleanroom particulate excursion rate during live aseptic operations over the last 12 months is 3 incidents/1000h.

information_points.title: Aseptic operator qualification（VAL）
information_points.content:
QAL-VAL-20U：Vanguard Parenteral Manufacturing demonstrated an aseptic gowning qualification pass rate of 96% among all manufacturing operators assigned to the sterile suites over the last 12 months.
QAL-VAL-KHR：Nexus BioPharma Services recorded an aseptic gowning qualification pass rate of 92% across all manufacturing personnel assigned to the candidate sterile suites over the past 12 months.
QAL-VAL-MMB：AuraBio Sterile Solutions achieved an aseptic gowning qualification pass rate of 100% for all manufacturing operators assigned to the candidate sterile suites over the last 12 months.
